title: Chinese Fried Peanuts
ldIngredientsRaw: pinch of salt for garnishing ( , to taste)
ldInstructionsRaw: Add peanuts along with the oil to a pan and then turn on the fire to medium slow fire. Shake your pan and stir the peanuts from time to time.
After 4-5 minutes, there will be “pa” sound in the pan. Turn off the heat and shake the pan for another minute. Transfer out and filter any oil.
Add 1 teaspoon of liquor and garnish salt. Mix well. Serve after completely cooled down.
